name: Neural Photon Field Rendering
aliases: Wavefront Path Tracing with Neural Fields
definition: A GPU path tracer that computes only the first interaction with the volume to estimate direct illumination, then queries the trained photon field for indirect global illumination.
summary: Neural Photon Field Rendering is a GPU-based path tracing method that replaces expensive secondary ray tracing with neural network inference to predict indirect illumination, reducing noise and computational cost.
